Thanks Priya / Lena — I dug through telemetry and the request sheet. Summary from Product: 

- Audit logs: Hosted API currently logs request-level metadata (timestamp, model id, route, request id, token counts, error flags) and keeps logs for 90 days by default. We can produce CSV extracts with those fields today.
- Retention windows: Hosted defaults are 90 days (configurable for Dedicated + Private). For Dedicated we already offer retention policy controls per-tenant; for Hosted we can offer an SLA-backed 365-day option as a contract term (requires ops approval).
- Evidence formatting: we can provide time-series CSVs and a sanitized sample request payload for redaction checks (Tom: confirm format ok).

Open questions for Infra: do we have a supported workflow for a temporary retention exception (e.g., extend retention to 2 years for a limited dataset and then auto-purge)? Also need clarity on BYOK scope — product will not recommend holding production PHI on hosted without BYOK or Private.

Action items (Product):
- Prepare example audit CSV + column definitions (ETA 48 hours).
- Draft MAP that captures the evidence delivery schedule + signoffs (ETA 72 hours).

-Marissa

Thanks team — technical notes from Infra / Runtime perspective: 

- BYOK/KMS: Current status: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) for encrypted-at-rest volumes and for model artifact encryption. Hosted does not support full BYOK today; we have a roadmap item to add envelope-encryption with customer keys for request payloads, but that is scoped for H2 2027.

- Short-term options: For the POC we can offer 
  1) Dedicated environment (recommended) with KMS bound to the tenant — fastest path and no code changes.
  2) Hosted + encrypted data escrow: create a short-lived export of the relevant artifacts into a customer-controlled storage bucket and provide encrypted evidence packages (manual workflow). This is more manual and requires a signed exception + limited access SOP.

- Retention carveouts: We can implement a scoped retention extension using a tag-based purge job. Implementation estimate: 
  - Quick manual carveout + manual purge run: 3 business days (ops runbook + approval)
  - Automated time-limited carveout with audit trail: ~4 weeks (small infra task + QA)

- Audit logs export: we can produce CSV or JSONL exports; signing and chain-of-custody metadata will be added to the runbook.

Risks: Hosted + PHI without BYOK is a risk we should avoid for production; POC can proceed with manual mitigations.

I’ll add a brief tech note to the MAP and flag JIRA-SEC-4921 for the BYOK epic.

-Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
